specTemplate.name: Instrumentation Tube Fitting
specTemplate.description: Compression tube fittings for instrument lines: form, ferrule system, end connections, tube size range, pressure, material.

categories.name: Instrumentation Tube Fittings
categories.shortDescription: 316 stainless steel instrumentation tube fittings, double and single ferrule: connectors, unions, elbows, tees, crosses, bulkhead fittings, adapters, reducers, caps, plugs, nuts and ferrules.
categories.seoDescription: 316 stainless instrumentation tube fittings, double and single ferrule: male and female connectors, unions, elbows, tees, bulkhead fittings and ferrules.

hero.intro: Compression tube fittings in 316 stainless steel for instrument, sampling and control lines, in double-ferrule and single-ferrule systems.

guidance.heading: Double or single ferrule
guidance.body: A double-ferrule fitting grips the tube with a back ferrule and seals with a front ferrule; a single-ferrule fitting does both with one. The two systems are not interchangeable: keep nuts, ferrules and bodies from the same system, and match the fitting to the tube outside diameter.

standards.heading: Rated to the tube
standards.body: A tube fitting holds the pressure of the tube it is made up on. Each listing carries the manufacturer's working pressures for 316 stainless tubing by outside diameter and wall thickness.

items.a: Fractional-inch outside-diameter tube from 1/16" to 2", plus metric tube on the metric connectors. Choose the wall thickness from the pressure table on each listing.

items.q: Do you list equivalent part numbers?
items.a: Where the manufacturer cross-references a Swagelok part number, the size table shows it beside the Indus part number.

categories.name: Double Ferrule Tube Fittings
categories.shortDescription: 316 stainless double-ferrule tube fittings: male and female connectors, unions, elbows, tees, crosses, bulkhead fittings, port connectors, adapters, reducers, caps, plugs, nuts and ferrules.
categories.seoDescription: 316 stainless double-ferrule instrumentation fittings: connectors to NPT, BSPP and SAE, unions, elbows, tees, bulkhead fittings, nuts and ferrule sets.

hero.intro: Double-ferrule compression fittings in 316 stainless steel, sized from 1/16" to 2" tube.

guidance.heading: How a double-ferrule fitting seals
guidance.body: As the nut is made up, the back ferrule pushes the front ferrule into the body and grips the tube, while the front ferrule seals against the body and the tube. Make up to the turns the manufacturer specifies and use ferrules from the same system.

standards.heading: Materials
standards.body: Bodies are forged or machined from 316L stainless bar to ASTM A479 / A276, as the manufacturer states on each listing.

items.a: Yes: front ferrules, back ferrules, ferrule sets and nuts are listed as their own parts.

categories.name: Single Ferrule Tube Fittings
categories.shortDescription: 316 stainless single-ferrule tube fittings: male and female connectors, unions, elbows, tees, crosses, bulkhead fittings, adapters, reducers, caps, plugs, nuts and ferrules.
categories.seoDescription: 316 stainless single-ferrule instrumentation fittings: connectors to NPT, BSPP, BSPT and SAE, unions, elbows, tees, bulkhead fittings and ferrules.

hero.intro: Single-ferrule compression fittings in 316 stainless steel, including metric-tube connectors.

guidance.heading: How a single-ferrule fitting seals
guidance.body: One ferrule both grips and seals the tube as the nut is made up. Single-ferrule parts do not interchange with double-ferrule ones, so keep a line on one system.

standards.heading: Materials
standards.body: Bodies are 316L stainless steel from bar to ASTM A479 / A276, as the manufacturer states on each listing.

items.q: Do you have metric single-ferrule connectors?
items.a: Yes: the metric male connector covers metric tube from 2 mm to 38 mm to BSPT male threads.

products.title: 316 Stainless Double Ferrule Female Flare Connector, Tube × 37° JIC Female
products.focusKeyword: double ferrule tube to jic female connector
products.descriptionShort: 316 Stainless Double Ferrule Female Flare Connector, Tube × 37° JIC Female in 316L stainless steel, forged. 6 part numbers, 1/8" to 3/4" tube; the size table gives the size on each end for every Indus part number.
products.descriptionLong:
The 316 Stainless Double Ferrule Female Flare Connector, Tube × 37° JIC Female is an instrumentation tube fitting in 316L stainless steel, forged. Its tube end uses a nut with a front and a back ferrule that grip and seal on the outside of the tube; the manufacturer designs it to hold its seal through vibration, temperature swings and pressure cycling in instrument, sampling and control lines.

Construction

  • Form: Female Flare Connector, Tube × 37° JIC Female
  • Ferrule system: double (front and back) ferrule
  • End 1: tube end (nut and ferrules)
  • End 2: 37° JIC female swivel
  • Material: 316L stainless steel, forged
  • Bar stock: ASTM A479, ASTM A276

Ends and sealing

  • Tube end: a nut with a front and a back ferrule that grip and seal on the outside of the tube. Fit it to tube of the listed outside diameter; the pressure the joint holds depends on the tube wall.
  • 37° JIC: 37° flare, a metal-to-metal seat on a 74° included cone; SAE J514 / ISO 8434-2.

Sizes

6 part numbers, 1/8" to 3/4" tube. The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists the size on each end for every one.

  • End 1: 1/8" tube to 3/4" tube
  • End 2: 1/8" JIC 37° (5/16-24) to 3/4" JIC 37° (1-1/16-12)

products.descriptionLong:
The 316 Stainless Single Ferrule Positionable Run Tee, Tube × SAE Straight Thread Male is an instrumentation tube fitting in 316L stainless steel, forged. Its tube end uses a nut with a single ferrule that grips and seals on the outside of the tube; the manufacturer designs it to hold its seal through vibration, temperature swings and pressure cycling in instrument, sampling and control lines.

Construction

  • Form: Positionable Run Tee, Tube × SAE Straight Thread Male
  • Ferrule system: single ferrule
  • End 1: tube end (nut and ferrule)
  • End 2: SAE straight thread male
  • Material: 316L stainless steel, forged
  • Bar stock: ASTM A479, ASTM A276

Ends and sealing

  • Tube end: a nut with a single ferrule that grips and seals on the outside of the tube. Fit it to tube of the listed outside diameter; the pressure the joint holds depends on the tube wall.
  • SAE straight thread: SAE straight thread sealed by an O-ring; SAE J1926.

Sizes

8 part numbers, 3/4" to 1/2" tube. The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists the size on each end for every one.

  • End 1: 3/4" tube to 1/2" tube
  • End 2: 3/4" SAE straight thread to 1/2" SAE straight thread
